name: Dipak Samantarai

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Dipak Samantarai brings poetry, broadcasting and heritage work together. His career with All India Radio spanned more than three decades, and his literary work includes the Odia poetry collections ‘Chhai Aluara Pashakhela’, ‘Kanthalekha’ and ‘Shosa’. His profile on the Cuttack Heritage website also records his work as editor and translator of ‘Seven Horses’.

In ‘Troubled Dawn’, the ordinary promise of morning falters: the sky hesitates, birds wait and a mother reaches for sleep. The poem moves from these domestic rhythms to a microscopic, spiked presence whose laughter overwhelms human suffering. Its short lines give the unfolding scene a suspended, unsettled pace.
